name: [Shoptet CLI Greenfield] Research & Design (Pre-Phase)
description:
Part of the "Shoptet Partner CLI — Greenfield Rebuild" initiative (no Initiative issue type exists in this project, so this label groups the whole effort: `shoptet-cli-greenfield`).

Research and design work that produced the consolidated greenfield blueprint (`cli-greenfield.md`), which defines the MVP (init/validate/dev/build) and the end-game (ownership boundary + host-owned runtime) for the Shoptet Partner CLI, replacing the four legacy repos (create-visual-addon-boilerplate, shoptet-bender, addon-repository-github-app, templates-assets).

This epic covers work already completed and is tracked for provenance.
